nodes.description: External caller address; used as token holder, as token contract in the ERC677 callback, and as the access-control subject for onlyOwner/onlyMediator/onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner.
Block timestamp consumed through the 'now' keyword inside getCurrentDay, making daily-limit accounting time dependent.
EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>uint256) holding limits, totals, fees and gas configuration.
EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>address) holding owner, bridge, mediator, token image and token pair addresses.
EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>bool) holding the initialized flag and message-fixed flags.
EternalStorage mapping(bytes32=>int256) holding forwarding lane rules.
Storage slot constant keccak256('owner') used to store/read the contract owner.
Storage slot constant for the AMB bridge contract address.
Storage slot constant for the mediator contract address on the other side.
Storage slot constant for the gas limit used in AMB message execution.
Storage slot constant storing the number of registered reward addresses.
Storage slot constant for the token image (implementation) used by TokenProxy.
Storage slot constant for the initialization flag.
Constant identifier for the home-to-foreign fee type.
Constant identifier for the foreign-to-home fee type.
Relative fee denominator constant (1 ether == 100%).
Sentinel head/tail address of the reward-address linked list (also used as ANY_ADDRESS wildcard).
Reads the owner address from addressStorage[OWNER].
Internal ownership setter; requires non-zero address and writes addressStorage[OWNER].
External onlyOwner function transferring contract ownership.
Public view computing 'now / 1 days'; the timestamp-dependent accounting primitive.
Validates the outgoing amount against dailyLimit, maxPerTx and minPerTx for a token.
Validates the incoming amount against executionDailyLimit and executionMaxPerTx.
Internal accounting addition of an outgoing amount for a token/day using SafeMath.add.
Internal accounting addition of an executed amount for a token/day using SafeMath.add.
External onlyOwner update of the outgoing daily limit for a token.
External onlyOwner update of the outgoing maximum amount per transaction.
External onlyOwner update of the outgoing minimum amount per transaction.
External onlyOwner update of the incoming execution daily limit.
Internal bridging entry point: limit checks, spent accounting, reentrancy lock, transferFrom, then message pass.
Public bridging entry points (two overloads) delegating to _relayTokens.
Public ERC677 transfer callback; guarded by the same lock used by _relayTokens.
Applies fee, burns home tokens and passes the AMB message on outgoing transfers.
Encodes and sends the AMB message, persisting message token/value/recipient for failure recovery.
onlyMediator handler for already registered home tokens.
onlyMediator handler that deploys a TokenProxy for a new foreign token and seeds limits/fees.
Mints bridged tokens to the recipient minus the foreign-to-home fee.
Mints back tokens for a failed message rollback.
Common dispatch applying execution limits before mint/unlock.
onlyMediator rollback of a failed message; reads stored token/recipient/value.
Requests the other side to fix a failed message by sending an AMB message.
onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner withdrawal of unregistered tokens or native coins.
onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner external call into a bridged token contract to claim tokens.
onlyRelevantSender initializer for bridge/mediator/limits/owner/token image/rewards/fees.
Splits the collected fee between reward addresses, transferring or minting per direction.
Internal pseudo-random helper based on blockhash(block.number-1).
Computes fee as value * fee / MAX_FEE using SafeMath.
Helper resolving the actual receiver from sender plus optional 20-byte data.
Returns the minter contract used for minting bridged tokens.
Scales default limits to a token's decimals using exponentiation, mul and div.
Computes min(maxPerTx, remaining daily quota) for a token.
Public view getFee and external onlyOwner setFee for a fee type/token pair.
Resolves the destination lane from wildcard forwarding rules.
Internal onlyOwner writer of forwarding lane rules into intStorage.
External call to an attacker-supplied ERC677 token transferring user funds; can re-enter via onTokenTransfer.
External call IBurnableMintableERC677Token(_token).burn(valueToBridge) on a user-supplied token address.
External call mint(_recipient, amount) on the token/minter contract during bridged and fixed execution.
External call into the AMB bridge contract to pass or confirm a cross-chain message.
External ERC677 transfer of fee amounts to reward addresses; may invoke a token callback.
Low-level native value send with selfdestruct fallback performed by Address.safeSendValue.
Amount of tokens to bridge, parameter of _relayTokens.
Receiver on the other side, parameter of _relayTokens.
Bridged token contract address, parameter of _relayTokens.
Sender address supplied by the ERC677 token callback, parameter of onTokenTransfer.
Optional callback payload carrying an alternative receiver, parameter of onTokenTransfer.
Local amount remaining after fee deduction before burning.
Local fee amount computed and distributed during a transfer.
Local iteration pointer over the reward-address linked list.
Local per-account share of the collected fee.
Local computed daily total (spent/executed plus amount) compared to the limit.
Message identifier parameter of fixFailedMessage.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership/_setOwner.
New daily limit parameter of setDailyLimit.
Local decimal-scaling factor used in _initializeTokenBridgeLimits.
Local mint amount after foreign-to-home fee deduction.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the token holder to token.transferFrom inside _relayTokens.
msg.sender is cast to ERC677 and used as the bridged token inside onTokenTransfer.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner() before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner guards setDailyLimit against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner guards setMaxPerTx against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner guards setMinPerTx against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner guards setExecutionDailyLimit against non-owner callers.
onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner compares msg.sender to the storage-proxy upgradeability owner in claimTokens.
onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner gates the external claimTokensFromTokenContract call.
onlyMediator requires msg.sender == bridgeContract() before fixFailedMessage runs.
onlyMediator gates handleBridgedTokens.
onlyMediator gates deployAndHandleBridgedTokens.
onlyRelevantSender gates initialize to the proxy owner or the contract itself.
onlyOwner guards setFee against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner guards the internal _setForwardingRule writer.
'now' (block.timestamp) is the sole input of getCurrentDay, creating a timestamp dependency in limit accounting.
getCurrentDay supplies the day key used by withinLimit when reading daily totals.
getCurrentDay supplies the day key used by withinExecutionLimit.
getCurrentDay is called inside onTokenTransfer to record the spent amount.
getCurrentDay is called inside _relayTokens to record the spent amount.
The computed day is the _day argument of addTotalSpentPerDay.
The computed day is the _day argument of addTotalExecutedPerDay.
transferOwnership delegates the actual owner write to the internal _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the new owner into addressStorage[OWNER], the privileged slot.
owner() reads the value stored under the OWNER slot.
setDailyLimit writes the daily limit into uintStorage.
setMaxPerTx writes the maximum per transaction into uintStorage.
setMinPerTx writes the minimum per transaction into uintStorage.
setExecutionDailyLimit writes the execution limit into uintStorage.
addTotalSpentPerDay accumulates the daily spent total in uintStorage with SafeMath.add.
addTotalExecutedPerDay accumulates the daily executed total in uintStorage with SafeMath.add.
withinLimit reads totalSpentPerDay, dailyLimit, maxPerTx and minPerTx from uintStorage.
withinExecutionLimit reads executed totals and execution limits from uintStorage.
maxAvailablePerTx reads maxPerTx, dailyLimit and totalSpentPerDay from uintStorage.
_setForwardingRule persists the lane value into intStorage.
destinationLane / forwardingRule reads lane values from intStorage.
initialize checks and sets the INITIALIZED storage flag.
initialize stores the AMB bridge contract address.
initialize stores the counterpart mediator address.
initialize stores the request gas limit.
initialize stores the token image implementation address.
relayTokens is the external wrapper that delegates to _relayTokens.
_relayTokens validates the bridged amount with withinLimit before moving funds.
_relayTokens increases the daily spent counter for the token.
_relayTokens invokes the external token.transferFrom call after setting the lock.
_relayTokens proceeds to bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer after locking.
onTokenTransfer checks the amount with withinLimit before accounting.
onTokenTransfer increments the daily spent counter for the token.
onTokenTransfer resolves the receiver through chooseReceiver(_from, _data).
onTokenTransfer forwards control to bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer triggers fee distribution before burning.
bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer burns the bridged value on the external token contract.
bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer calls passMessage to notify the other side.
passMessage calls bridge.requireToPassMessage or requireToConfirmMessage.
passMessage consults destinationLane to pick the AMB message method.
_handleBridgedTokens gates execution with withinExecutionLimit.
_handleBridgedTokens increments the executed-per-day counter.
_handleBridgedTokens dispatches to executeActionOnBridgedTokens when in limits.
handleBridgedTokens resolves the home token then calls _handleBridgedTokens.
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens calls _handleBridgedTokens for the new token.
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens seeds per-token limits via _initializeTokenBridgeLimits.
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens copies default fees to the new token with setFee/_setFee.
executeActionOnBridgedTokens mints valueToMint to the recipient on the external token.
executeActionOnBridgedTokens distributes the FOREIGN_TO_HOME fee before minting.
executeActionOnFixedTokens mints the full value back through the minter contract.
fixFailedMessage executes the rollback mint via executeActionOnFixedTokens.
fixFailedMessage relies on mediatorContractOnOtherSide() validated through onlyMediator.
requestFailedMessageFix sends the fix request through the AMB bridge external call.
_distributeFee uses random(numOfAccounts) to pick the remainder recipient.
_distributeFee transfers fee shares with ERC677(_token).transfer in the home-to-foreign direction.
_distributeFee mints fee shares with _getMinterFor(_token).mint in the foreign-to-home direction.
_distributeFee computes the total fee with calculateFee.
calculateFee obtains the fee rate through the getFee/setFee accessor pair.
_distributeFee walks the reward linked list starting from the F_ADDR sentinel.
claimTokens routes to claimValues and then to the native value send in Address.safeSendValue.
_initializeTokenBridgeLimits computes scaled limits with exponentiation/mul/div and writes them into uintStorage.
The ERC677 token invokes onTokenTransfer after transferFrom, re-entering the mediator (mitigated by the lock flag).
An ERC677 fee transfer may re-enter the mediator through the onTokenTransfer callback.
_value parameter carries the bridged amount into _relayTokens.
_receiver parameter carries the destination receiver into _relayTokens.
_token parameter carries the bridged token contract into _relayTokens.
_from parameter carries the callback sender into onTokenTransfer.
_data parameter carries optional receiver override data into onTokenTransfer.
Local valueToBridge is reduced by the fee and burned.
Local fee is the amount deducted from the bridged value.
Local nextAddr iterates the reward list during fee distribution.
Local feePerAccount is the per-account fee share computed by division.
Local nextLimit is the summed daily total compared against the configured limit.
_messageId parameter selects the stored message data in fixFailedMessage.
newOwner parameter is validated and written to the privileged owner slot.
_dailyLimit parameter is validated and written to uintStorage by setDailyLimit.
Local factor is the 10**n decimal scaling factor used to derive limits.
Local valueToMint is the post-fee amount actually minted to the recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: Transient amount argument of _relayTokens only; fold into the enclosing bridging function.
Transient destination argument of _relayTokens; fold into the enclosing bridging function.
Transient token address argument of _relayTokens; fold into the enclosing bridging function.
Callback sender argument supplied by the ERC677 token; fold into onTokenTransfer.
Optional callback payload argument of onTokenTransfer; fold into onTokenTransfer.
Local post-fee burn amount used only inside bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer.
Local fee accumulator of bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer; fold into that function.
Local linked-list cursor used only inside the _distributeFee loop.
Local per-account fee share computed and consumed only in _distributeFee.
Local aggregated daily total compared against the limit inside withinLimit.
Message identifier argument consumed only by fixFailedMessage.
New owner argument validated and stored by the internal _setOwner writer.
Limit argument validated and persisted only by setDailyLimit.
Local decimal scaling exponent used only within _initializeTokenBridgeLimits.
Local post-fee mint amount consumed only by executeActionOnBridgedTokens.
